content:
marta: Heads-up — we've got a compliance ask to reduce PII in request/response logs. Need an actionable plan for sampling + redaction that works with Dedicated & Private.
kevin: rough idea: classify routes by PII-risk and apply route-level sample rates. low-risk 5%, med 25%, high 100% but redacted.
alex: high should not be 100% unredacted. prefer 100% but with strict field redaction + encryption at rest. :lock:
sophia: can we do schema-driven redaction? eg. redact 'email', 'ssn', 'credit_card' fields automatically.
marta: yes. also need deterministic sampling for dedupe/alerting — so we can tie traces without keeping raw PII.
kevin: agree. use hashing-on-hash-salt to sample, store only hashed id in telemetry index.
alex: UX question: console toggle per-route for breakglass access? ops wants a button to temporarily enable full logs for a route with audit trail.
sophia: support for canary rollout of new sampler rules. rollout config should accept percent and fallback.
olivia: infra note: redaction should happen before any downstream sinks (s3, datadog). Can't rely on client-side.
sre-bot: deploy queued: deploy/sampler-v2 scheduled to canary in prod at 04:00 UTC.
kevin: here's a minimal sampler config I prototyped:
```yaml
sampler:
  version: 2
  default: { sample_rate: 0.05, redact: ["headers.Authorization"] }
  routes:
    - pattern: "^/v1/embeddings"
      pii_level: low
      sample_rate: 0.05
      redact: [ "body.user_email" ]
    - pattern: "^/v1/payments"
      pii_level: high
      sample_rate: 1.0
      redact: [ "body.card_number", "body.cvc", "body.user_email" ]
  deterministic_keys: ["user_id", "request_id"]
  hash_salt: "<SECRET_SALT>"
```
kevin: note the high route still redacts card_number + cvc; full bodies are never persisted in plain text.
marta: what about retention/lookup for debug? security wants ability to retrieve original for legal holds.
alex: propose: store encrypted blobs in compliance S3 bucket with strict IAM + HSM-wrapped keys and an approval flow.
sophia: approval flow must record approver, reason, TTL. auto-delete after TTL.
olivia: also need to change console to show sampling rates per route in the route detail panel and show 'effective sample (%)'.
kevin: metrics: we must expose sampled_count, total_count, estimated_total via extrapolation in dashboards.
marta: logging-levels: keep 'audit' for every CanAccess event that toggles breakglass. that must be un-sampled.
sophia: edge case: streaming responses with incremental tokens — PII can leak in later tokens. need streaming scrub hooks.
alex: implement token-level redaction -> replace sensitive tokens with <REDACTED> and maintain kv-cache mapping hashed keys.
olivia: timeline: can we ship a safe default (schema redaction + low default rates) this week and canary the deterministic sampler next week?
kevin: yes. I'll open the PR with tests and e2e using synthetic PII data.
marta: blockers: need legal sign-off on retention + retrieval flow. cc @legal-team.
kevin: ack. I'll add docs for console UX and operator runbook.
olivia: also add a telemetry flag to opt routes into exempt-mode for enterprise customers who requested full logging under contract.
marta: final ask: please include a short that we can paste into the release notes about 'improved PII-safe sampling and redaction defaults'.
kevin: will draft a blurb.
alex: one-liner for release notes: "Sampler v2: route-aware sampling + automatic schema redaction; encrypted retrieval for approved legal requests." :thumbsup:
marta: thanks all. I'll follow up with a checklist and assign owners.
